description: Department of Fiscal Policy - The Finance (Carbon Tax) Regulations No. 01 of 2019
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the implementation of regulations under the Finance Act, No. 35 of 2018, specifically the Finance (Carbon Tax) Regulations. It details legal/regulatory procedures for tax collection and remittance, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation." While a minister is named, the core content is regulatory rather than about government personnel or structure.
